## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any user or operator impact.

## Related work

Link the issue, requirements, and Given-When-Then acceptance criteria. Use `Closes #...` only when this pull request resolves the issue.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed and their outcomes. For behavior changes, include the failing acceptance case and the passing result. State which relevant checks were not run and why.

## Screenshots and operational impact

For visible changes, include screenshots using fictional data. Describe migrations, configuration changes, dependency licenses, or deployment steps when applicable. Write `Not applicable` for sections that do not apply.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] The change includes relevant acceptance coverage and documentation, or explains why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I recorded validation results and any limitations above.
- [ ] I removed unrelated changes, generated artifacts, credentials, and private client data from this submission.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the MIT License and have identified any third-party material and its notices.
